caption:
🚨 1,250+ LOTS END TOMORROW NIGHT 🚨

This week's Galax online auction is our biggest in a while: DeWalt and Craftsman tools, appliances, kitchen goods, yard equipment and home items from major retailer returns, closeouts and overstock. Bidding is open now, and lots start closing Friday at 7 PM.

🛠️ TOOLS & SHOP
• 12 in. sliding compound miter saw, deep cut band saw and DeWalt 18 in. scroll saw
• DeWalt 20V XR hammer drill, 20V air inflator, circular saws and a PEX expansion tool
• Craftsman 6 gal pancake air compressor and wet/dry shop vacs
• Craftsman V20 4-tool combo kit plus dozens of DeWalt and Craftsman batteries and chargers

❄️ APPLIANCES & KITCHEN
• Frigidaire, Whirlpool and LG over-the-range microwaves (new)
• Frigidaire Gallery upright freezers and a 7 cu ft chest freezer
• Frigidaire retro compact 2-door fridge
• Nugget ice maker, soft serve maker, countertop microwaves, cast iron and dinnerware

🌿 YARD & OUTDOOR
• Craftsman V20 20 in. self-propelled and 15 in. battery mower kits
• Craftsman V20 hedge trimmer and chainsaw, Kobalt 40V leaf blower
• Kobalt 7 cu ft yard cart and a Kemimoto flip windshield for Polaris Ranger

🏡 HOME & MORE
• Cal king comforter set, king mattress topper, dehumidifier, Away carry-on
• Pull-down kitchen faucet, insulated catering hot box, 12-egg incubator and much more

Tag someone who needs tools, a freezer or a new mower 👇

Lots begin closing Friday, November 6 at 7 PM ET. Pickup at 299 E Virginia St, Galax, VA. Condition ranges from new to open box to used and as-is, so check each listing's photos and notes before you bid.
